title: SSC CGL Tier-1 English (Eduquity Pattern) — Day 1: Set 1
subject: English Language

questions.q: The newly appointed chief executive officer has been working under the assumption that the quarterly revenue targets could be achieved without downsizing the operations department.
o: had been worked under the assumption
questions.instruction: Choose the option that provides the correct/improved form of the sentence.

explanation.explanation: The Present Perfect Continuous “has been working” correctly describes an action that began in the past and is still continuing. “Under the assumption” is the standard expression, so no improvement is required.
explanation.hindi: “Has been working” ऐसे कार्य के लिए सही है जो अतीत में शुरू हुआ और अभी भी जारी है। “Under the assumption” मानक expression है, इसलिए सुधार आवश्यक नहीं है.

questions.q: The committee members, having spent over three hours deliberating the intricate nuances of the corporate merger, was explicitly reluctant to ratify the proposed clause despite the chairperson’s persuasive remarks.
o: The committee members, having spent over three hours
deliberating the intricate nuances of the corporate merger,
was explicitly reluctant to ratify the proposed clause
questions.instruction: Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, choose “No Error”.

explanation.explanation: The subject “committee members” is plural, so the verb must be “were”, not “was”. The phrase “having spent...” does not change the subject.
explanation.hindi: “Committee members” plural subject है, इसलिए verb “were” होना चाहिए, “was” नहीं। “Having spent...” subject को नहीं बदलता.

questions.q: The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness, "Can you state with absolute certainty that you observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight?"
o: The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he could state with absolute certainty that he observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he could state with absolute certainty that he had observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney inquired from the prime witness that whether he can state with absolute certainty that he had observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he can state with absolute certainty that he observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
questions.instruction: Choose the correct indirect-speech form of the given sentence.

explanation.explanation: The reporting verb “asked” is in the past, so “can” changes to “could”. The observation occurred earlier, so “had observed” appropriately represents that earlier action. An indirect question takes “if/whether”, not “that whether”.
explanation.hindi: “Asked” past में है, इसलिए “can” सामान्यतः “could” होता है। Observation पहले हुई थी, इसलिए “had observed” उपयुक्त है। Indirect question में “if/whether” आता है, “that whether” नहीं.

questions.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the most logical sequence.

explanation.explanation: R introduces the broad issue of the power-grid overhaul. P identifies the intermittency problem. Q presents battery storage as the solution, and S gives the consequence of lacking that storage. Therefore, the sequence is RPQS.
explanation.hindi: R power-grid overhaul का व्यापक विषय देता है। P intermittency की समस्या बताता है। Q battery storage का solution देता है और S storage न होने का परिणाम बताता है। इसलिए क्रम RPQS है.

sentences.label: P

sentences.label: Q
sentences.text: To resolve this grid instability, engineering firms are investing heavily in advanced lithium-ion battery storage infrastructure.

sentences.label: R

questions.q: Despite of the unrelenting downpour and the subsequent waterlogging across the primary arterial roads, the dedicated medical staff managed to reach the emergency ward right on time.
o: and the subsequent waterlogging across the primary arterial roads,
the dedicated medical staff managed to reach
the emergency ward right on time.
questions.instruction: Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, choose “No Error”.

explanation.explanation: “Despite” is not followed by “of”. The correct forms are “Despite the unrelenting downpour” or “In spite of the unrelenting downpour”.
explanation.hindi: “Despite” के बाद “of” नहीं आता। सही रूप “Despite the unrelenting downpour” या “In spite of the unrelenting downpour” है.

questions.q: The architectural firm meticulously designed the futuristic blueprint of the smart city to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
o: The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was being meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
The futuristic blueprint of the smart city had been meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
To ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources, the futuristic blueprint of the smart city is meticulously designed by the architectural firm.
questions.instruction: Choose the correct passive-voice form of the given sentence.

explanation.explanation: The active sentence is in the Simple Past (“designed”). Its passive form is “was/were + past participle”, giving “was meticulously designed”.
explanation.hindi: “Designed” Simple Past है, इसलिए passive में “was/were + V3” आएगा। सही रूप “was meticulously designed” है.

questions.q: The project coordinator said to the team members, "Do not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month."
o: The project coordinator warned the team members not to compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays the following month.
The project coordinator told the team members to not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator ordered the team members that they should not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator warned the team members against compromising on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays the following month.
questions.instruction: Choose the correct indirect-speech form of the given sentence.

explanation.explanation: A negative imperative can be reported with “warned/told + object + not to”. Because the reporting verb is in the past, “will” becomes “would”, and “next month” becomes “the following month”.
explanation.hindi: Negative imperative को “warned/told + object + not to” से report किया जा सकता है। Past reporting के कारण “will” → “would” और “next month” → “the following month” होता है.

questions.q: The diplomatic delegation decided to call off on the bilateral negotiations after the host country abruptly altered the pre-negotiated trade tariffs.
o: call out on the bilateral negotiations
questions.instruction: Choose the option that provides the correct/improved form of the sentence.

explanation.explanation: “Call off” means to cancel. The sentence needs “call off the bilateral negotiations”; the extra “on” is incorrect.
explanation.hindi: “Call off” का अर्थ cancel करना है। सही phrase “call off the bilateral negotiations” है; “on” गलत है.

questions.q: Had the meteorological department issued the emergency severe weather warning a few hours prior, the coastal administrative authorities would have successfully evacuated the vulnerable low-lying regions.
o: the emergency severe weather warning a few hours prior,
the coastal administrative authorities would have successfully evacuated
questions.instruction: Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, choose “No Error”.

explanation.explanation: This is a correctly formed third conditional in inversion: “Had + subject + past participle ..., subject + would have + past participle.” There is no error.
explanation.hindi: यह inversion वाला correctly formed third conditional है: “Had + subject + V3 ..., subject + would have + V3.” कोई error नहीं है.

questions.q: Analysts are closely monitoring the fluctuating patterns of the stock index to predict the upcoming economic correction.
o: The fluctuating patterns of the stock index are being closely monitored by analysts to predict the upcoming economic correction.
The fluctuating patterns of the stock index were closely monitored by analysts to predict the upcoming economic correction.
The fluctuating patterns of the stock index are closely monitored by analysts to predict the upcoming economic correction.
The upcoming economic correction is being predicted by analysts by closely monitoring the fluctuating patterns of the stock index.
questions.instruction: Choose the correct passive-voice form of the given sentence.

explanation.explanation: The active sentence is in the Present Continuous (“are monitoring”). Its passive form is “are being + past participle”, giving “are being closely monitored”.
explanation.hindi: “Are monitoring” Present Continuous है, इसलिए passive में “are being + V3” आएगा। सही रूप “are being closely monitored” है.

questions.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the most logical sequence.

explanation.explanation: R introduces the broad socio-economic transformation. Q adds urban migration and its effects on housing and family structures, establishing the demographic shift referred to by “This demographic shift” in P. S then gives a consequence for municipal planning. Therefore, the logical sequence is RQPS.
explanation.hindi: R व्यापक socio-economic transformation को प्रस्तुत करता है। Q urban migration और उसके प्रभाव बताता है, जिससे P का “This demographic shift” स्पष्ट होता है। S इसके बाद municipal planning का consequence देता है। इसलिए क्रम RQPS है.

sentences.label: P
sentences.text: This demographic shift has created an unprecedented demand for flexible healthcare policies that prioritize preventative care over emergency treatments.

sentences.label: Q
sentences.text: Furthermore, urban migration has compressed the available housing space, fundamentally altering family structures and support systems for the elderly.

sentences.label: R
sentences.text: Over the past two decades, the nation has witnessed a substantial transformation in its socio-economic landscape due to rapid industrial growth.

sentences.label: S
sentences.text: Consequently, municipal corporations are forced to re-evaluate their city planning layout to accommodate both commercial zoning and residential wellbeing.
